description: This file defines the RouteGroup class in the Slim Framework, which manages route grouping including middleware handling, route collection, and pattern management within the routing system.

classes.name: RouteGroup
classes.description: Implements a route group in the Slim Framework, allowing route definitions, middleware additions, and integration with dispatchers.

methods.name: collectRoutes
methods.description: Resolves the route's callable and invokes it with the route collector proxy to register routes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the route group, accepting any middleware type.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface instance to the middleware list.

methods.name: appendMiddlewareToDispatcher
methods.description: Adds all middleware in the group to the given MiddlewareDispatcher.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the route pattern associated with the group.
